mapper.sql: po.po_id poId, po.item_code itemCode, i.item_name itemName, po.vendor_id vendorId, v.vendor_name vendorName, po.order_qty orderQty, po.procurement_due procurementDue, po.supply_price supplyPrice, po.po_status poStatus, CAST(po.is_closed AS UNSIGNED) isClosed
mapper.select: SELECT , COALESCE(SUM(r.accepted_qty),0) acceptedQty, COUNT(DISTINCT ts.stmt_id) statementCount FROM purchase_order po JOIN item i ON i.item_code=po.item_code JOIN vendor v ON v.vendor_id=po.vendor_id LEFT JOIN receiving r ON r.po_id=po.po_id LEFT JOIN transaction_statement ts ON ts.receiving_id=r.receiving_id GROUP BY po.po_id,po.item_code,i.item_name,po.vendor_id,v.vendor_name,po.order_qty,po.procurement_due,po.supply_price,po.po_status,po.is_closed ORDER BY po.po_id DESC

SELECT s.shipment_id shipmentId,s.po_id poId,po.item_code itemCode,i.item_name itemName,po.vendor_id vendorId,v.vendor_name vendorName,po.order_qty orderQty,po.procurement_due procurementDue,po.supply_price supplyPrice,po.po_status poStatus,COALESCE(s.shipment_qty,po.order_qty) shipmentQty,s.make_status makeStatus,CAST(s.on_time_flag AS UNSIGNED) onTimeFlag,s.shipped_at shippedAt,s.expected_arrival_date expectedArrivalDate,COALESCE((SELECT SUM(rx.accepted_qty) FROM receiving rx WHERE rx.po_id=po.po_id),0) previousAcceptedQty,COALESCE(inv.available_qty,0) currentAvailableQty,pp.process_needed processNeeded,pp.required_schedule requiredSchedule,pp.required_qty requiredQty,(SELECT c.agreed_terms FROM contract c JOIN quote q ON q.quote_id=c.quote_id WHERE q.plan_id=po.plan_id AND c.vendor_id=po.vendor_id ORDER BY c.contract_id DESC LIMIT 1) agreedTerms FROM shipment s JOIN purchase_order po ON po.po_id=s.po_id JOIN procurement_plan pp ON pp.plan_id=po.plan_id JOIN item i ON i.item_code=po.item_code JOIN vendor v ON v.vendor_id=po.vendor_id LEFT JOIN inventory inv ON inv.item_code=po.item_code LEFT JOIN receiving r ON r.shipment_id=s.shipment_id WHERE r.receiving_id IS NULL ORDER BY COALESCE(s.expected_arrival_date,DATE(s.shipped_at)),s.shipment_id

SELECT r.receiving_id receivingId,r.shipment_id shipmentId,r.po_id poId,po.item_code itemCode,i.item_name itemName,v.vendor_name vendorName,r.result,r.received_qty receivedQty,r.accepted_qty acceptedQty,r.rejected_qty rejectedQty,r.rejection_reason rejectionReason,r.inspected_at inspectedAt,ts.stmt_id statementId,pr.return_id returnId,pr.status returnStatus,inv.available_qty availableQty,CAST(pp.is_completed AS UNSIGNED) planCompleted FROM receiving r JOIN purchase_order po ON po.po_id=r.po_id JOIN procurement_plan pp ON pp.plan_id=po.plan_id JOIN item i ON i.item_code=po.item_code JOIN vendor v ON v.vendor_id=po.vendor_id LEFT JOIN transaction_statement ts ON ts.receiving_id=r.receiving_id LEFT JOIN purchase_return pr ON pr.receiving_id=r.receiving_id LEFT JOIN inventory inv ON inv.item_code=po.item_code ORDER BY r.receiving_id DESC

SELECT pr.return_id returnId,pr.receiving_id receivingId,pr.vendor_id vendorId,v.vendor_name vendorName,pr.item_code itemCode,i.item_name itemName,pr.return_qty returnQty,pr.return_reason returnReason,pr.status,pr.requested_at requestedAt,pr.completed_at completedAt FROM purchase_return pr JOIN vendor v ON v.vendor_id=pr.vendor_id JOIN item i ON i.item_code=pr.item_code ORDER BY pr.return_id DESC

SELECT inv.item_code itemCode,i.item_name itemName,inv.base_date baseDate,inv.base_qty baseQty,inv.available_qty availableQty,inv.calc_qty calcQty,inv.stock_value stockValue,inv.release_ready_status releaseReadyStatus,inv.updated_at updatedAt FROM inventory inv JOIN item i ON i.item_code=inv.item_code ORDER BY inv.item_code

SELECT iss.issue_id issueId,iss.item_code itemCode,i.item_name itemName,iss.request_id requestId,iss.release_qty releaseQty,iss.issue_qty issueQty,iss.status,iss.requested_at requestedAt,iss.issued_at issuedAt,COALESCE(inv.available_qty,0) availableQty,COALESCE(inv.base_qty,0) baseQty,COALESCE(inv.stock_value,0) stockValue,pr.input_process inputProcess,pr.schedule_date scheduleDate,pr.required_qty requiredQty FROM `issue` iss JOIN item i ON i.item_code=iss.item_code LEFT JOIN inventory inv ON inv.item_code=iss.item_code LEFT JOIN production_request pr ON pr.request_id=iss.request_id AND DATE(iss.requested_at)>=#{fromDate}AND DATE(iss.requested_at)<=#{toDate}AND iss.item_code=#{itemCode}AND iss.status=#{status} ORDER BY CASE WHEN iss.status='REQUESTED' THEN 0 WHEN iss.status='PARTIAL' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END,iss.issue_id DESC

SELECT inv.item_code itemCode,i.item_name itemName,inv.base_qty baseQty,inv.available_qty availableQty,inv.calc_qty calcQty,COALESCE((SELECT ts.supply_price FROM transaction_statement ts JOIN receiving r ON r.receiving_id=ts.receiving_id JOIN purchase_order po ON po.po_id=r.po_id WHERE po.item_code=inv.item_code ORDER BY ts.created_at DESC LIMIT 1),CASE WHEN inv.calc_qty>0 THEN inv.stock_value/inv.calc_qty ELSE 0 END) unitPrice,inv.stock_value stockValue,inv.updated_at updatedAt,COALESCE((SELECT SUM(h.transaction_qty) FROM inventory_history h WHERE h.item_code=inv.item_code AND h.transaction_type='ISSUE' AND DATE(h.created_at)>=#{fromDate}AND DATE(h.created_at)<=#{toDate}),0) periodIssueQty FROM inventory inv JOIN item i ON i.item_code=inv.item_code AND inv.item_code=#{itemCode} ORDER BY inv.item_code

SELECT ts.stmt_id statementId,ts.receiving_id receivingId,po.po_id poId,ts.vendor_id vendorId,v.vendor_name vendorName,i.item_name itemName,ts.qty,ts.supply_price supplyPrice,CAST(ts.is_notified AS UNSIGNED) isNotified,ts.created_at createdAt FROM transaction_statement ts JOIN receiving r ON r.receiving_id=ts.receiving_id JOIN purchase_order po ON po.po_id=r.po_id JOIN item i ON i.item_code=po.item_code JOIN vendor v ON v.vendor_id=ts.vendor_id ORDER BY ts.stmt_id DESC

SELECT po.po_id poId,po.item_code itemCode,i.item_name itemName,v.vendor_name vendorName,po.order_qty orderQty,po.procurement_due procurementDue,po.po_status poStatus,po.created_at orderDate,COALESCE(SUM(r.accepted_qty),0) acceptedQty,CAST(po.is_closed AS UNSIGNED) isClosed FROM purchase_order po JOIN item i ON i.item_code=po.item_code JOIN vendor v ON v.vendor_id=po.vendor_id LEFT JOIN receiving r ON r.po_id=po.po_id AND DATE(po.created_at)>=#{fromDate}AND DATE(po.created_at)<=#{toDate}AND po.po_status=#{status}AND (CAST(po.po_id AS CHAR) LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR i.item_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR v.vendor_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%')) GROUP BY po.po_id,po.item_code,i.item_name,v.vendor_name,po.order_qty,po.procurement_due,po.po_status,po.created_at,po.is_closed ORDER BY po.created_at DESC

SELECT po.po_id poId,i.item_name itemName,v.vendor_name vendorName,po.order_qty orderQty,SUM(r.accepted_qty) acceptedQty,MAX(r.inspected_at) completedAt FROM purchase_order po JOIN receiving r ON r.po_id=po.po_id JOIN item i ON i.item_code=po.item_code JOIN vendor v ON v.vendor_id=po.vendor_id WHERE po.is_closed=0 AND r.accepted_qty>0 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM receiving rx LEFT JOIN transaction_statement ts ON ts.receiving_id=rx.receiving_id WHERE rx.po_id=po.po_id AND rx.accepted_qty>0 AND ts.stmt_id IS NULL) GROUP BY po.po_id,i.item_name,v.vendor_name,po.order_qty ORDER BY completedAt DESC

SELECT ts.stmt_id statementId,ts.created_at createdAt,ts.qty,ts.supply_price supplyPrice,(ts.qty*ts.supply_price) totalPrice,ts.is_notified isNotified,r.inspected_at inspectedAt,po.po_id poId,po.item_code itemCode,i.item_name itemName,v.vendor_id vendorId,v.vendor_name vendorName,tsp.order_company_info orderCompanyInfo,tsp.vendor_info vendorInfo,tsp.agreed_terms agreedTerms FROM transaction_statement ts JOIN receiving r ON r.receiving_id=ts.receiving_id JOIN purchase_order po ON po.po_id=r.po_id JOIN item i ON i.item_code=po.item_code JOIN vendor v ON v.vendor_id=ts.vendor_id JOIN transaction_statement_prep tsp ON tsp.prep_id=ts.prep_id WHERE ts.stmt_id=#{statementId}

SELECT s.shipment_id shipmentId,s.po_id poId,COALESCE(s.shipment_qty,po.order_qty) shipmentQty,po.item_code itemCode,po.vendor_id vendorId,po.supply_price supplyPrice,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM receiving r WHERE r.shipment_id=s.shipment_id) alreadyReceived FROM shipment s JOIN purchase_order po ON po.po_id=s.po_id WHERE s.shipment_id=#{shipmentId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT receiving_id receivingId FROM receiving WHERE receiving_id=#{receivingId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT item_code itemCode,available_qty availableQty FROM inventory WHERE item_code=#{itemCode} FOR UPDATE

SELECT iss.issue_id issueId,iss.item_code itemCode,iss.request_id requestId,COALESCE(iss.release_qty,0) releaseQty,COALESCE(iss.issue_qty,0) issueQty,iss.status,COALESCE(inv.available_qty,0) availableQty,COALESCE((SELECT ts.supply_price FROM transaction_statement ts JOIN receiving r ON r.receiving_id=ts.receiving_id JOIN purchase_order po ON po.po_id=r.po_id WHERE po.item_code=iss.item_code ORDER BY ts.created_at DESC LIMIT 1),CASE WHEN inv.calc_qty>0 THEN inv.stock_value/inv.calc_qty ELSE 0 END,0) unitPrice FROM `issue` iss LEFT JOIN inventory inv ON inv.item_code=iss.item_code WHERE iss.issue_id=#{issueId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO inventory(item_code,base_date,base_qty,available_qty,release_ready_status,calc_qty,stock_value) VALUES(#{itemCode},CURRENT_DATE,0,#{qty},'AVAILABLE',#{qty},#{qty}*COALESCE(#{unitPrice},0)) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE available_qty=available_qty+VALUES(available_qty),calc_qty=calc_qty+VALUES(calc_qty),stock_value=stock_value+VALUES(stock_value),release_ready_status='AVAILABLE'
mapper.update: UPDATE `issue` SET issue_qty=COALESCE(issue_qty,0)+#{qty},status=#{status},issued_by=#{userId},issued_at=CASE WHEN #{status}='COMPLETED' THEN NOW() ELSE issued_at END WHERE issue_id=#{issueId}

UPDATE inventory SET available_qty=available_qty-#{qty},calc_qty=GREATEST(calc_qty-#{qty},0),stock_value=GREATEST(stock_value-(#{qty}*COALESCE(#{unitPrice},0)),0),release_ready_status=CASE WHEN available_qty-#{qty}>0 THEN 'AVAILABLE' ELSE 'OUT_OF_STOCK' END WHERE item_code=#{itemCode} AND available_qty>=#{qty}
UPDATE production_request SET status=#{status} WHERE request_id=#{requestId}
UPDATE purchase_order SET po_status='IN_PROGRESS' WHERE po_id=#{poId} AND po_status IN ('PLANNED','ORDERED')

UPDATE procurement_plan pp JOIN purchase_order po ON po.plan_id=pp.plan_id SET pp.is_completed=1 WHERE po.po_id=#{poId} AND (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(r.accepted_qty),0) FROM receiving r WHERE r.po_id=po.po_id)>=COALESCE(po.order_qty,0) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM purchase_return pr JOIN receiving rr ON rr.receiving_id=pr.receiving_id WHERE rr.po_id=po.po_id AND pr.status<>'COMPLETED')
UPDATE purchase_return SET status=#{status},completed_at=CASE WHEN #{status}='COMPLETED' THEN NOW() ELSE NULL END WHERE return_id=#{returnId}
mapper.select: SELECT r.receiving_id receivingId,r.accepted_qty acceptedQty,po.vendor_id vendorId,po.supply_price supplyPrice,(SELECT c.contract_id FROM contract c JOIN quote q ON q.quote_id=c.quote_id WHERE q.plan_id=po.plan_id AND c.vendor_id=po.vendor_id ORDER BY c.contract_id DESC LIMIT 1) contractId FROM receiving r JOIN purchase_order po ON po.po_id=r.po_id LEFT JOIN transaction_statement ts ON ts.receiving_id=r.receiving_id WHERE r.receiving_id=#{receivingId} AND r.accepted_qty>0 AND ts.stmt_id IS NULL FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO transaction_statement_prep(contract_id,order_company_info,vendor_info,agreed_terms) SELECT c.contract_id,c.order_company_info,v.vendor_name,c.agreed_terms FROM contract c JOIN vendor v ON v.vendor_id=c.vendor_id WHERE c.contract_id=#{contractId}
mapper.update: UPDATE transaction_statement SET is_notified=1 WHERE stmt_id=#{statementId}

UPDATE purchase_order po SET po_status='CLOSED',is_closed=1 WHERE po.po_id=#{poId} AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM receiving r WHERE r.po_id=po.po_id AND r.accepted_qty>0) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM receiving r LEFT JOIN transaction_statement ts ON ts.receiving_id=r.receiving_id WHERE r.po_id=po.po_id AND r.accepted_qty>0 AND ts.stmt_id IS NULL)
